stage: Exploratory repair of the masking-versus-refitting mismatch. Locked before fitting this guard or inspecting its external results; 14 previously used PMLB datasets, all 42 existing outer folds. No further changes to the tolerance.
split: Retain the original reference-training rows. Stratify the archived ranking partition 50:50 into proposal and refit-guard rows with seed 39823 + fold. Training, proposal, guard and external rows are mutually disjoint. An insufficient class count is a recorded failure, not an invitation to move rows.
rule: Fit the same tree on training rows. Fit the compact Gain anchor using proposal rows only. Propose S using the four-panel separating minimum on the proposal rows. Refit S and A on reference-training plus proposal rows. Choose S if its guard AUC and accuracy each lose at most 3% relative to A (also 5% positive AP for the ranking-design rare-positive case), else choose A. Finally refit on all outer development rows. The guard is one unbootstrapped independent deployment comparison. This cannot guarantee future risk.
ablations: Identical partitions for all arms. Compare A, unguarded and guarded vote, unguarded and guarded same-width Gain prefix (width donated by vote), and an independently sized baseline using the first ceil(k_anchor/2) Gain columns with and without the very same guard. This last baseline uses the same number of independent refit choices without voting. Record duplicate supports and standalone potential and actual shared fits; do not treat the estimated shared costs as standalone timing.
endpoints: Equal-task average of fold AUC, accuracy, retention fraction, number of fallbacks. Report fold counts exceeding the original guard tolerance on the same outer labels relative to A. Report specificity vs extra columns and observed false accepts/rejections. No significance claims, no claim of discovering this method. One hour per fold.
